title: The Grunion Run, xiv
logline: Fourteenth year. Wagner's dark behind them. Wood carries the dog to the surf line and sets him at the water's edge and the dog puts one paw in.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. GULLY and MARIA at the thermos, the baby in a carrier on Maria. WOOD carrying BARNABY down the sand.

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns, a couple at a thermos with a baby in a carrier, a thin man carrying an old dog down the sand toward the surf, muddy watercolor

panels.composition: Wood setting the dog down at the water's edge, among the fish.

image.prompt: a man gently setting an old dog down at a surf line flashing with small silver fish, lantern light, no words

panels.composition: The dog's one paw in the water. A fish against it. The dog looking at it.

image.prompt: close-up of an old dog's paw in shallow water with a small silver fish against it, the dog looking down, no words

panels.composition: Silent. The fish. The lanterns. The dog at the edge, one paw in. Wood beside him on the sand. Twelve years of this beach in one paw.

characters.pose: on the sand beside the dog

notes: One paw in. The last Grunion Run the dog goes to.
